set.approach: From the boat ramp parking at Anthony Lake, hike the Hoffer Lakes Trail to the higher Hoffer Lake. Scramble up and around the slabs on the south side of the lake to a meadow; both the Upper and Lower Walls sit in the little valley southwest of it. A faint trail leads to the base of the Lower Wall and continues steeply along the foot of the escarpment to the Upper Wall. The route is the face immediately right of Wide Bottom.
set.descent_text: Scramble up the wide gully on the left side of the face to reach the big ledge on top, where the left anchor serves Chisel Queen. It sits well back from the edge, so long slings help when belaying from below.

review.notes: Area page for approach and the gully to the anchors; route page for the start and anchor position.
